events.title: Demo Update #2 – Quality of Life & Improvements
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has played the Trade or Threat demo and shared their feedback!This small update focuses on improving the first-time player experience, making interactions clearer, and polishing several gameplay systems.Quality of LifeImproved Barrel Installation: Expanded the interaction area to make installing the quest barrel easier and more intuitive.New Health Indicator: Added a three-segment health bar with animated damage feedback.Adjustable Brightness: Added a brightness slider
